You can't debug or control cost for what you can't see, and raw prompts are radioactive to store.

So measure the shape of each request: time to first token, total latency, tokens in and out, cost, model and version, route, cache and retrieval signals, plus error and 429 rates. Log that metadata, redact or drop the prompt text, keep full traces to a tiny opt-in sample, and set retention short.
